capabilities: Hide tracked filenames from the file explorer via a runtime stylesheet
List tracked files in a side pane mirroring the folder tree
Open tracked files from the pane, including in a new leaf
Re-render the pane on file create, delete, and rename
extras: The community listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; matching is exact and case-sensitive, so pattern matching is not supported.
problem: AI agent instruction files placed at multiple folder levels clutter the file explorer while remaining files you want quick access to.
summary: File pane plugin that hides AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and similar files from the file explorer and lists them in a dedicated folder-tree sidebar.
